✦ Ask the Knowledge Wiki

Questions are answered using indexed local evidence. A cloud LLM is OFF by default; opt-in is only available through the private local server. Gmail and Drive metadata are refreshed by the local scheduled connector when authorised. Ledger records are read only through the private local server.

About Vāyú Knowledge Sphere

This is a local, self-contained 3D-projected knowledge graph. It opens from your computer without cloud subscriptions. Graph records and Wiki Markdown live in the companion project folder.

  • Drag / touch to rotate; mouse wheel or +/− to zoom.
  • Use Pulse ON/OFF to control subtle traveling light along graph connections. The pulses are decorative, not live-data status. Reduced-motion accessibility settings are respected.
  • Click a node, category or search result to inspect the underlying source ledger.
  • Use tabs to browse linked evidence, chronology and relationships.
  • The search is deterministic local retrieval, not a live LLM response.
  • Some records were indexed by document title only. No unverified source content is represented as read or approved.
  • Personal and proprietary business data should stay in a private folder or access-controlled deployment, not a public GitHub Pages repo.
